lines.en: label cafe20:
scene cafetwentyredux
Rin spots me from behind the counter but, instead of calling out to me, she just...turns around.
lines.zh: Rin 从柜台后面看到了我，但她没有喊我，只是……转过身去。

lines.en: No. She turns around and {i}pretends to start cleaning something.{/i} Which is an obvious sign that she doesn't want to talk to me...but why?
lines.zh: 不。她是转过身去，{i}假装在擦什么东西{/i}。这明显是她不想跟我说话的信号……可为什么呢？

lines.en: I can't recall doing anything wrong, but I guess it's in my nature to sort of do things like that without realizing.
lines.zh: 我想不出自己做错了什么，不过大概我的本性就是会不知不觉干出这种事。

lines.en: She's one of the last people I'd expect to just avoid me, though.
lines.zh: 可她是我最想不到会躲着我的那类人之一。

lines.en: Or maybe it's something that doesn't involve me at all?
lines.zh: 或者，也许这根本跟我没关系？

lines.en: scene black
Maybe, in my selfish obsession with all things flowing into me, I just expected it to be.
lines.zh: 也许，在我把所有事都往自己身上揽的那份自私执念里，我只是希望它跟我有关。

lines.en: And meanwhile, she's drowning in a different lake.
lines.zh: 而与此同时，她正溺在另一片湖里。

lines.en: scene cafesad1
: Rin?
lines.zh: : Rin？

lines.en: : Oh, S-Sensei! Fancy...meeting you here.
lines.zh: : 哦，S、Sensei！真巧……在这儿碰上你。

lines.en: : How are you doing this morning? Everything good? Have any...cool dreams or something?
lines.zh: : 今天早上过得怎么样？一切都好吗？有没有……做什么很酷的梦之类的？

lines.en: : I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 我挺好的。

lines.en: : The real question is how are {i}you?{/i}
lines.zh: : 真正的问题是{i}你{/i}怎么样？

lines.en: : Oh, you know...Pretty good. Can't complain.
lines.zh: : 哦，你懂的……挺好的。没什么可抱怨的。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: Obviously, I know that's not true.
lines.zh: 显然，我知道这不是真的。

lines.en: It's not like Rin to just...hide away.
lines.zh: Rin 不是那种会……躲起来的人。

lines.en: At the same time, though...what do I even know about her to begin with?
lines.zh: 不过同时……我到底又了解她多少呢？

lines.en: It's not like I've experienced what becomes of her in times of crises before. This could just be par for the course.
lines.zh: 我以前也没见过她在危机时刻会变成什么样。这说不定就是常态。

lines.en: But, if that's the case, why do I still feel compelled to push further when that is likely the last thing she wants me to do?
lines.zh: 可如果是这样，为什么在明知追问大概最违背她意愿的情况下，我仍然觉得非推一把不可？

lines.en: scene happy9
scene cafesad1
: How was your doctor’s appointment the other day?
lines.zh: : 前几天去看医生的结果怎么样？

lines.en: : I never got a chance to ask you.
lines.zh: : 我一直没机会问你。

lines.en: : Uhh...pretty good, I guess. Blood pressure is fine. BMI is fine. You know the deal.
lines.zh: : 呃……挺好的吧。血压正常。BMI 正常。就那么回事。

lines.en: : Good to hear.
lines.zh: : 听你这么说我就放心了。

lines.en: : Would you mind turning around by any chance? It feels kind of weird talking to the back of your head.
lines.zh: : 你介意转过来吗？对着你的后脑勺说话感觉怪怪的。

lines.en: : Yeah...about that...
lines.zh: : 嗯……关于这个……

lines.en: : I actually...kind of {i}would{/i} mind. I don’t look so great today.
lines.zh: : 其实我还{i}真的{/i}介意。我今天不太好看。

lines.en: : I’m not here to judge a beauty pageant.
lines.zh: : 我可不是来当选美评委的。

lines.en: : That's good, because I wouldn't even make it past auditions looking like this.
lines.zh: : 那还好，因为我现在这副样子连海选都过不了。

lines.en: : Just turn around, Rin.
lines.zh: : 转过来就是了，Rin。

lines.en: : Why do I have to?...
lines.zh: : 为什么非得转啊？……

lines.en: : Because I don't care what you look like right now.
lines.zh: : 因为我不在乎你现在长什么样。

lines.en: scene cafesad2
: But that doesn't mean it isn't weird for me...
lines.zh: : 可这不代表对我来说不奇怪啊……

lines.en: : I just don’t want you to think anything’s going on or whatever because I know you were already worrying and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想让你觉得发生了什么之类的，因为我知道你本来就一直在担心什么的。

lines.en: : So like, if you want to just order something and leave your money on the counter, that’s-
lines.zh: : 所以，你要是想点个东西、把钱放柜台上就走，那就——

lines.en: : Rin. Turn around.
lines.zh: : Rin。转过来。

lines.en: : Okay, but if you run away, my feelings will be really hurt.
lines.zh: : 好，不过你要是跑了，我会很受伤的。

lines.en: : I won’t run.
lines.zh: : 我不会跑。

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: scene cafesad3
: Good morning...
lines.zh: : 早上好……

lines.en: She wasn’t kidding when she said she didn’t look good today...It looks like she hasn’t slept in weeks.
lines.zh: 她说自己今天不好看时可没开玩笑……她看起来像好几个星期没睡过觉。

lines.en: She’s drenched in sweat and her eyes are swollen so badly that she can't even fully open them.
lines.zh: 她浑身被汗浸透，眼睛肿得都睁不全。

lines.en: : Good morning, Rin.
lines.zh: : 早上好，Rin。

lines.en: scene cafesad4
: So, uhh...how bad is it?
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……有多糟？

lines.en: : It’s, uhh...
lines.zh: : 这个，呃……

lines.en: : Let’s just say you’ve had better days.
lines.zh: : 只能说，你也有过更好的日子。

lines.en: scene cafesad5
: I feel fucking gross...I haven’t even showered in like a week.
lines.zh: : 我感觉恶心死了……我大概一个星期都没洗澡了。

lines.en: : Are you really okay to be working right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在真的适合上班吗？

lines.en: scene cafesad3
: Yeah, I'm good...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我没事……

lines.en: : Besides, I can't let Haruka run the place by herself since the only other girl on the schedule for this morning called out today.
lines.zh: : 再说，今天早上排班里唯一的另一个女孩请假了，我不能让 Haruka 一个人撑着店。

lines.en: scene cafesad6
: Oh, and if you could forget you ever saw me like this, that would be nice. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，如果你能忘了自己见过我这副样子，那就太好了。谢啦。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if that’s possible.
lines.zh: : 我不确定那做得到。

lines.en: : Are you...really okay?
lines.zh: : 你……真的没事吗？

lines.en: scene cafesad3
: Well, it’s not like you’ve been believing me even when I say yes, so...
lines.zh: : 反正我说没事你也不信，所以……

lines.en: The two of us stand there in silence for an uncomfortable amount of time before I feel the need to speak up again.
lines.zh: 我们两个就这么沉默地站了很久，久到让人不自在，我才觉得有必要再开口。

lines.en: I doubt she'll bite, but I at least need to cast some sort of lure that might tempt her to...go home or...
lines.zh: 我怀疑她不会上钩，但我至少得抛出点什么诱饵，好引她……回家什么的……

lines.en: I don't know. I should probably learn literally anything about fishing before attempting to make fishing analogies.
lines.zh: 我不知道。在试图打钓鱼的比方之前，我大概该先学点关于钓鱼的知识。

lines.en: : You should ask to go home. I’ll work the rest of your shift for you if I really have to.
lines.zh: : 你该申请回家。实在不行的话，你剩下的班我来替你上。

lines.en: scene cafesad5
: Sensei...I know you’re worried, but you really don’t have to do that...
lines.zh: : Sensei……我知道你担心，可你真的不用这样……

lines.en: : I’ve been through much worse and you don’t even know the drinks...this job isn't something you can just jump into, you know.
lines.zh: : 我经历过比这更糟的，而且你连饮料都不会做……这活儿不是说上手就能上手的，你知道的。

lines.en: : You need tons of training and...
lines.zh: : 你需要大量的培训，而且……

lines.en: : I’ll be okay.
lines.zh: : 我会没事的。

lines.en: : I promise. I just need a few minutes to-
lines.zh: : 我保证。我只是需要几分钟来——

lines.en: : Stop saying you’re going to be okay when you have no idea if that's true or not.
lines.zh: : 别再说你会没事了，你根本不知道那是不是真的。

lines.en: scene cafesad7
Rin stops speaking and jolts up in surprise.
lines.zh: Rin 猛地一惊，停住了话头。

lines.en: : I’m not going to pretend to know how you feel or even...what's going on. But I'm pretty damn sure that forcing yourself to stay out in public isn’t going to help.
lines.zh: : 我不会假装知道你是什么感受，甚至不清楚……到底发生了什么。但我相当确定，硬逼着自己待在公共场合不会有任何帮助。

lines.en: : Get out of here. Go lay down. Try to get some rest. Do literally anything.
lines.zh: : 离开这儿。去躺下。试着休息一下。做什么都行。

lines.en: : I'm not-
lines.zh: : 我不是——

lines.en: : When was the last time you slept?
lines.zh: : 你上一次睡觉是什么时候？

lines.en: : That's...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: scene cafesad4
: Um...three days ago?
lines.zh: : 嗯……三天前？

lines.en: : Four, maybe?...
: A week?
lines.zh: : 一个星期？

lines.en: : Why? What’s keeping you awake?
lines.zh: : 为什么？什么让你睡不着？

lines.en: : That’s not exactly easy to answer, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 这个可不好回答，Sensei……

lines.en: : And I don’t really want to talk about it so...
lines.zh: : 而且我真的不想谈这个，所以……

lines.en: scene cafesad3
: If you could like...maybe just give me a little space or something...
lines.zh: : 你能不能……大概给我一点空间什么的……

lines.en: : Will that help you?
lines.zh: : 那对你有帮助吗？

lines.en: : Well...it won’t {i}hurt{/i} me...
lines.zh: : 嗯……至少不会{i}伤害{/i}到我……

lines.en: The sound of hurried footsteps rounding the corner suddenly interrupts our conversation.
lines.zh: 一阵急促的脚步声绕过拐角，突然打断了我们的对话。

lines.en: scene cafesad8
: Rin, please go home...Molly is going to come in and work for you.
lines.zh: : Rin，你回家吧……Molly 会来替你上班。

lines.en: : Molly? Seriously? There's no way you and Molly can work an opening shift yourselves. That's only slightly better than you working alone.
lines.zh: : Molly？真的假的？你和 Molly 两个人怎么可能撑得起早班。那也就比你自己一个人强一点点。

lines.en: : I'll figure it out. And Rin, if you’re ever not feeling well...please let me know.
lines.zh: : 我会想办法的。还有 Rin，你要是身体不舒服……请一定告诉我。

lines.en: : I can’t make you work when you’re like this.
lines.zh: : 我不能让你这副样子还上班。

lines.en: scene cafesad8r
: I can do it, though! Really!
lines.zh: : 可我能行的！真的！

lines.en: : I just...didn’t have time to do my makeup this morning!
lines.zh: : 我只是……今天早上没时间化妆而已！

lines.en: : And you look beautiful even without it. That’s not why I’m sending you home.
lines.zh: : 你不化妆也很好看。我不是因为那个才让你回家的。

lines.en: : I don’t want you to have to worry about helping customers on top of whatever else is going on right now.
lines.zh: : 我不想让你在已经扛着别的事的情况下，还要操心招待客人。

lines.en: : So do as your teacher says and go get some rest, okay?
lines.zh: : 所以听你老师的话，去休息一下，好吗？

lines.en: Was...Haruka listening this entire time?
lines.zh: 等等……Haruka 一直都在听？

lines.en: : We’ll talk more about your schedule as soon as you’re feeling better.
lines.zh: : 等你感觉好些了，我们再详细聊你的排班。

lines.en: : Until then, I'm going to have to take you off.
lines.zh: : 在那之前，我只能先不给你排班。

lines.en: scene cafesad9
: Ngh-!
Rin clenches her teeth, frustrated by the sudden realization of her weakness not just to her peers, but to herself.
lines.zh: Rin 咬紧牙关，被自己突然暴露出的软弱弄得又沮丧又难堪——不只是在同龄人面前，更是在她自己面前。

lines.en: Why she wants to keep picking at a wound before it's even had the chance to scab over, I don't know.
lines.zh: 我不明白，她为什么非要在一道还没结痂的伤口上一遍遍去抠。

lines.en: But watching that won't do any of us good and will only make the healing process that much harder if it's ever given the opportunity to start.
lines.zh: 可看着她这么做对我们谁都没好处；而且只要给它一点机会开始愈合，这么做只会让愈合的过程难上加难。

lines.en: Before us lies a girl on the verge of breaking and all we can do is attempt to cushion the blow as she's hurled from the twenty-third story of a building we can't see the top of.
lines.zh: 躺在我们面前的，是一个濒临崩溃的女孩；而她正被人从一栋看不见顶的楼的二十三楼抛下来，我们能做的只有尽力去垫一垫。

lines.en: I say, as if I made any sort of difference at all.
lines.zh: 我说得像是我真起了什么作用似的。

lines.en: scene cafesad10
: I’m sorry, Haruka...
lines.zh: : 对不起，Haruka……

lines.en: scene cafesad11
: I’m sorry, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 对不起，Sensei……
: 我会……

lines.en: scene cafesad11r
: I’ll get better soon! I promise!
lines.zh: : 我很快就会好起来的！我保证！

lines.en: scene black
Rin quickly grabs her things from underneath the counter and runs out of the store in the direction of the dorms.
lines.zh: Rin 迅速从柜台下面抓起自己的东西，朝着宿舍的方向跑出了店门。

lines.en: I hope she's able to get some sleep once she arrives but, at this point, who's to say if she will?
lines.zh: 我希望她到了之后能睡一会儿，不过事到如今，谁说得准呢？

lines.en: Haruka lets out a heavy sigh as if the weight of the world has been lifted off of her shoulders before turning her attention to me and displaying an expression halfway between exhausted and distressed.
lines.zh: Haruka 长长地舒了一口气，像是整个世界都从她肩上卸了下来，然后才转向我，露出一个介于疲惫与焦虑之间的表情。

lines.en: For a moment, it's almost like looking into a mirror.
lines.zh: 有那么一瞬间，几乎像是在照镜子。

lines.en: scene cafesad12
: Are you going to be okay with just you and that Molly girl?
lines.zh: : 就你和那个 Molly 两个人，撑得住吗？

lines.en: : Not a chance in hell...But you saw Rin. I couldn’t just let her stay here in that condition...
lines.zh: : 一点可能都没有……可你也看到 Rin 了。我不能让她那副样子还待在这儿……

lines.en: : I swear, she can be so...fucking stubborn sometimes...Is she like that in[school] too?
lines.zh: : 我发誓，她有时候真是……他妈的倔得要死……她在[school]也这样吗？

lines.en: : Not that I’ve seen. She zones out in class a lot but, most of the time, she's extremely energetic.
lines.zh: : 我没见过。她上课经常走神，但大多数时候精力特别旺盛。

lines.en: : I see...I take it that she hasn't told you the specifics then either?
lines.zh: : 这样啊……看来她也没跟你说具体情况了？

lines.en: : She won’t tell me anything.
lines.zh: : 她什么都不肯告诉我。

lines.en: : All I know is that sometimes she ‘thinks things she shouldn’t.’
lines.zh: : 我只知道，有时候她会「想一些不该想的东西」。

lines.en: scene cafesad13
: Don't we all kind of do that from time to time, though?
lines.zh: : 可我们不也都会时不时那样吗？

lines.en: : Maybe. It's hard to tell exactly what she meant by it since she just sort of stopped talking about it a few seconds later.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。很难说清她具体指什么，因为她没说几句就不往下说了。

lines.en: : I’ll go and check on her soon, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我很快会去看看她。

lines.en: scene cafesad14
: Good...I think she’d like that.
lines.zh: : 好……我想她会喜欢的。

lines.en: : She talks about you a lot, you know?
lines.zh: : 她经常提起你，你知道吗？

lines.en: : Ever since you started coming to the cafe. Now, every time you show up she gets really excited and won't shut up about you for like, an hour afterward.
lines.zh: : 从你开始来这家咖啡馆之后。现在每次你一来，她都特别兴奋，之后能有整整一个小时停不下嘴地聊你。

lines.en: I didn't realize there was even an hour worth of things to say about me?...
lines.zh: 我都不知道关于我还能聊上整整一个小时？……

lines.en: : Honestly, I’ve never seen her get that way with anyone before. Not even that blonde girl she has a crush on.
lines.zh: : 老实说，我从没见过她对谁那样过。连她暗恋的那个金发女孩都没有。

lines.en: : Oh. You know about that too?
lines.zh: : 哦。这事你也知道？

lines.en: scene cafesad15
: Of course. I mean, she hasn’t {i}told{/i} me or anything. But it’s not like she’s doing a great job of hiding it.
lines.zh: : 当然。我是说，她没{i}告诉{/i}我什么的。不过她藏得也实在不怎么高明。

lines.en: : Yeah, I guess she does get a little panicky whenever something involving Chika comes up.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我想只要一提到跟 Chika 有关的事，她就会有点慌。

lines.en: : Ahh, right. Right. Chika was her name. Thanks for reminding me.
lines.zh: : 啊，对。对。Chika 是她的名字吧。谢谢你提醒我。

lines.en: : I promise that I won’t tease her about it when she’s back to normal.
lines.zh: : 我保证等她恢复正常之后不会拿这事取笑她。

lines.en: : We can tease her about it together. I’m sure she'll be back to her normal routine in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 我们可以一起取笑她。我肯定她很快就会回到正常状态。

lines.en: scene cafesad14
: Yeah...I’m sure we will...
lines.zh: : 是啊……我们肯定会的……

lines.en: Haruka pauses for a moment.
lines.zh: Haruka 顿了一下。

lines.en: Her eyes scan the room, but not in a way that makes it look like she's searching for customers or tables to be cleaned.
lines.zh: 她的目光扫过整个店里，但那不像是正在找客人或者找要擦的桌子。

lines.en: It's a way that makes it seem like she's about to do something she doesn't want anyone to know about.
lines.zh: 那神情更像是在打算做一件不想让任何人知道的事。

lines.en: scene cafesad16
: Hey...so this might sound a little weird or something...but do you think you could maybe let me know whenever you {i}do{/i} check on Rin?
lines.zh: : 那个……这听起来可能有点怪什么的……不过你能不能在你{i}真的{/i}去看 Rin 的时候告诉我一声？

lines.en: : Just so I can know for sure she's fine.
lines.zh: : 好让我能确定她没事。

lines.en: : Why would that sound weird? And sure. I can try. I can’t guarantee I’ll be here every day, though.
lines.zh: : 为什么听起来会奇怪？当然可以。我尽量。不过我没法保证每天都来。

lines.en: : Well, yeah. That's the part where it gets kind of weird since...I was going to ask that you take down my number and just...text or call instead.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊。怪就怪在这儿，因为……我本来想请你记一下我的号码，然后……改成发短信或者打电话。

lines.en: : Sure. I can do that.
lines.zh: : 当然。没问题。

lines.en: scene cafesad17
: Oh, really?! C-Cool! Yeah...Yeah, that’s totally great.
lines.zh: : 哦，真的？！那、那太好了。是啊……是啊，这简直太棒了。

lines.en: : Let me...uhh...let me get a pen or something. I'll be right back.
lines.zh: : 我去……呃……我去找支笔什么的。马上回来。

lines.en: scene cafesad17r
Haruka...seems to forget that physically writing down phone numbers isn't necessary anymore and sets off to find a {i}pen or something.{/i}
lines.zh: Haruka……似乎忘了现在其实已经没必要把电话号码手写在纸上了，于是动身去找「{i}笔什么的{/i}」。

lines.en: She's able to find one without much effort and then proceeds to scribble down her number on the back of a napkin.
lines.zh: 她没费什么劲就找到了一支，然后在餐巾纸背面草草写下自己的号码。

lines.en: There’s a slight hesitation between each digit, as if she’s trying to convince herself it’s okay to be doing this.
lines.zh: 每写一个数字都带着一丝迟疑，像是她在努力说服自己这么做没问题。

lines.en: Of course, I think it is.
lines.zh: 当然，我觉得没问题。

lines.en: Though I may be immensely biased.
lines.zh: 虽然我可能有极大的偏见。

lines.en: scene cafesad14
: Okay, here you go.
lines.zh: : 好了，给你。

lines.en: : I’m kind of busy during the day, so....if I don’t answer right away, it’s nothing personal.
lines.zh: : 我白天挺忙的，所以……要是我没马上回，那不是针对你。

lines.en: : Got it. I’ll be sure to let you know if anything happens with Rin.
lines.zh: : 明白了。Rin 那边有什么情况我一定告诉你。

lines.en: : That aside, do you want me to hang around until Rin's cover gets here?
lines.zh: : 另外，你要我留下来等到 Rin 的替班来吗？

lines.en: : Because I told her earlier that I wouldn’t mind helping out a bit if necessary, but I can't guarantee I will be of any {i}actual{/i} help whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 因为我刚才跟她说了，必要的话我不介意帮点忙，但我不能保证我真的能帮上{i}什么{/i}忙。

lines.en: : No, no, no. It’s fine. I’ve worked alone before. I actually think it’s kind of relaxing.
lines.zh: : 不不不。没关系。我一个人干过。其实我觉得那样还挺放松的。

lines.en: scene cafesad15
: Just go cheer up my employee already. She needs it.
lines.zh: : 你赶紧去哄我的员工开心吧。她需要。

lines.en: : Works for me.
lines.zh: : 正合我意。

lines.en: : It was nice talking to you, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 跟你聊天很愉快，Haruka。

lines.en: : You too. I look forward to...further communication.
lines.zh: : 我也是。期待……进一步的联络。

lines.en: scene cafesad16
: I'm sorry. I have no idea why I said it like that.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我不知道自己为什么要那么说。

lines.en: : Yeah, that was weird.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那确实挺怪的。

lines.en: : Anyway, see you later.
lines.zh: : 总之，回头见。

lines.en: : Y-Yeah...Later.
lines.zh: : 好、好的……回头见。

lines.en: scene black
I leave the cafe without ever purchasing a drink.
lines.zh: 我离开了咖啡馆，什么都没买。

lines.en: It wouldn't be the same if it wasn't Rin who made it.
lines.zh: 如果不是 Rin 做的，那就不一样了。

lines.en: $ cafe20 = True
$ rin_love += 1
{i}Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin 的好感度提升到了 [rin_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
